title: Fry Dance R15 (Mobile and PC) "Universal "
script:
--==================================================
-- CONFIGURATION AND ASSET DOWNLOAD
--==================================================

-- Define the remote music URL and the local file name.
local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helloguyswelcometoanewvideo/musics-foruse-someday/main/ladancinamuchodance.mp3"
local file = "ladancinamuchodance.mp3"

-- Download the music only if the file does not already exist.
if not isfile(file) then
    local data = game:HttpGet(url)

    -- Validate the downloaded data before saving it.
    if #data >= 1000 then
        writefile(file, data)
    end
end


--==================================================
-- SERVICE INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Get the Roblox services required by the script.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- Store a reference to the local player.
local player = Players.LocalPlayer


--==================================================
-- LOADING NOTIFICATION
--==================================================

-- Display a notification when the controls are initialized.
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "loading..",
    Text = "Dance controls loaded",
    Duration = 15
})

-- Allow time for the notification to appear.
task.wait(3)


--==================================================
-- MUSIC INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Create and configure the background music instance.
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.SoundId = getcustomasset(file)
sound.Volume = 2
sound.Looped = true
sound.Parent = SoundService


--==================================================
-- HELPER FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Resolve an animation asset into its AnimationId.
-- Return the original asset ID if no Animation object is found.
local function anim2track(asset_id)
    local objs = game:GetObjects(asset_id)

    for i = 1, #objs do
        if objs[i]:IsA("Animation") then
            return objs[i].AnimationId
        end
    end

    return asset_id
end

-- Get the current character's Humanoid.
-- Wait for the character to spawn if necessary.
local function getHumanoid()
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION ASSET CONFIGURATION
--==================================================

-- Load the asset IDs for the three dance animations.
local animid = anim2track("rbxassetid://129991743366120")
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = animid

local anim2id = anim2track("rbxassetid://103108681887836")
local animation2 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation2.AnimationId = anim2id

local anim3id = anim2track("rbxassetid://112931882473990")
local animation3 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation3.AnimationId = anim3id


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION TRACK REFERENCES
--==================================================

-- Store the AnimationTrack objects after they are loaded.
local track
local track2
local track3


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION LOADING
--==================================================

-- Create an Animator if needed and load all three animations.
local function loadAnimations()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()

    -- Find the existing Animator or create a new one.
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

    if not animator then
        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        animator.Parent = humanoid
    end

    -- Load each animation and assign its playback priority.
    track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track2 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation2)
    track2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track3 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation3)
    track3.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
end

-- Initialize the animation tracks.
loadAnimations()


--==================================================
-- PLAYBACK STATE
--==================================================

-- Track whether playback is enabled and which dance is selected.
local playing = true
local activeDance = 1


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION CONTROL FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Stop all currently loaded dance animations.
local function stopAnimations()
    if track then track:Stop() end
    if track2 then track2:Stop() end
    if track3 then track3:Stop() end
end

-- Play the selected dance and stop the other animations.
local function playDance(index)
    -- Prevent dance animations from playing when playback is disabled.
    if not playing then return end

    if index == 1 then
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the first dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track and not track.IsPlaying then
            track:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 2 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the second dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track2 and not track2.IsPlaying then
            track2:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 3 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end

        -- Start the third dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track3 and not track3.IsPlaying then
            track3:Play()
        end
    end

    -- Save the currently selected dance index.
    activeDance = index
end


--==================================================
-- MUSIC AND ANIMATION PLAYBACK TOGGLE
--==================================================

-- Toggle music and dance playback on or off.
local function togglePlayback()
    playing = not playing

    if playing then
        -- Resume the music and the currently selected dance.
        sound:Play()
        playDance(activeDance)
    else
        -- Stop the music and all dance animations.
        sound:Stop()
        stopAnimations()
    end
end


--==================================================
-- INITIAL PLAYBACK
--==================================================

-- Start the background music and the first dance.
sound:Play()

if track then
    track:Play()
end


--==================================================
-- CHARACTER RESPAWN HANDLING
--==================================================

-- Reload animation tracks when the player respawns.
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)

    loadAnimations()

    -- Resume the selected dance if playback is enabled.
    if playing then
        playDance(activeDance)
    end
end)


--==================================================
-- MOBILE GUI INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Get the player's GUI container.
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Remove an existing copy to prevent duplicate interfaces.
local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DanceMobileControls")

if oldGui then
    oldGui:Destroy()
end


--==================================================
-- SCREEN GUI CONFIGURATION
--==================================================

-- Create the main screen interface.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DanceMobileControls"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 10000
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
gui.Parent = playerGui


--==================================================
-- CONTROL PANEL LAYOUT
--==================================================

-- Create a transparent panel to hold the control buttons.
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "DancePanel"
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8)
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 220)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Parent = gui

-- Arrange the buttons vertically with consistent spacing.
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
layout.Parent = panel


--==================================================
-- REUSABLE BUTTON FACTORY
--==================================================

-- Create a styled text button and connect its callback.
local function makeButton(label, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    -- Configure the button's identity and dimensions.
    button.Name = "Button" .. label
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)

    -- Configure the button's appearance.
    button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Text = label
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    -- Enable interaction and configure rendering order.
    button.Active = true
    button.Selectable = true
    button.ZIndex = 100
    button.Parent = panel

    -- Add a colored outline to the button.
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.5
    stroke.Transparency = 0
    stroke.Parent = button

    -- Add rounded corners to the button.
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = button

    -- Execute the supplied callback when the button is activated.
    button.Activated:Connect(callback)

    return button
end


--==================================================
-- DANCE SELECTION BUTTONS
--==================================================

-- Select dance animation 1.
-- Pressing the same button again does not stop the animation.
makeButton("1", function()
    playDance(1)
end)

-- Select dance animation 2.
makeButton("2", function()
    playDance(2)
end)

-- Select dance animation 3.
makeButton("3", function()
    playDance(3)
end)


--==================================================
-- MUSIC TOGGLE BUTTON
--==================================================

-- Keep the music control independent of dance selection.
local musicButton

musicButton = makeButton("OFF", function()
    togglePlayback()

    -- Update the button label to reflect the playback state.
    musicButton.Text = playing and "OFF" or "ON"
end)


--==================================================
-- KEYBOARD INPUT HANDLING
--==================================================

-- Handle keyboard shortcuts for playback and dance selection.
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

    -- Ignore inputs already handled by Roblox or another interface.
    if processed then return end

    -- Press P to toggle music and dance playback.
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        togglePlayback()
        musicButton.Text = playing and "OFF" or "ON"

    -- Press Z to select dance animation 1.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
        playDance(1)

    -- Press X to select dance animation 2.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then
        playDance(2)

    -- Press C to select dance animation 3.
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then
        playDance(3)
    end
end)
